findings.reason: as written the node cannot import the module it edits without a nonstandard late import (which E402 forbids) or a change of home for the shared parser, so the plan must say where the one parser lives (or drop the telemetry_store limb) or its own done-when cannot be met.
findings.text: "The change" puts the one parser in `serving_receipts` and says `_roll_date`, `_record_stem_and_suffix` and `telemetry_store._ladder_stem` "all call it"; because `serving_receipts` imports `telemetry_store` at module top (serving_receipts.py:75) and evaluates `telemetry_store.TIER_MINUTE` as a def default at import (serving_receipts.py:404), a top-level import of `serving_receipts` in `telemetry_store` makes `import imas_ambix.agent.telemetry_store` raise `AttributeError: partially initialized module ... has no attribute 'TIER_MINUTE'` — reproducibly triggered by `tests/test_telemetry_store.py:39` (`from imas_ambix.agent.telemetry_store import (...)`), one of the four files §23's own done-when requires to pass, and by telemetry_store's own `__main__` entry (telemetry_store.py:1314)

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `telemetry_store.py:982` resolves (the "arrives with a new inode" sentence is at :981-983), the three cited functions exist at serving_receipts.py:612/:650 and telemetry_store.py:798; the "reuse 12" citation resolves to the stored review r-20261015T084820771350-srw-raw-record-rolls-daily-repair (`scores.reuse == 12`), and its two follow-ons match §23's "What is wrong".
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §23's done-when names four test files, a pinned-former-result assertion, a module-search assertion, a docstring assertion, and a declared negative control ("makes `_ladder_stem` parse the day itself again, and the single-parser test must fail"), which is a control that can go red.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §23 names no gate path at all, so nothing is placed in a scratchpad or node-local temporary; the gate evidence is the run's own test logs.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §23 introduces no plan labels, ticket numbers or version tags into code symbols, and its new test is described by mechanism, not by a tracker id.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the root cause matches the cited evidence, but the stated mechanism cannot run on the real code path: placing the one parser in `serving_receipts` and having `telemetry_store._ladder_stem` call it makes `telemetry_store` import `serving_receipts`, which already imports `telemetry_store` at module top and reads `telemetry_store.TIER_MINUTE` as a def-default at import time (serving_receipts.py:404).
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — the node carries one deliverable (one roll-day parser) plus the docstring correction in the same file and mechanism.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §23's node `srw-roll-day-one-parser` runs after §21 and is recommended by open followup f-srw-030 (plan.html:1102) with the matching skill prompt `/reckon-build serving-record-warehouse §23`; no relationship is missing or mis-pointed.
